messages:
maya: Morning — noticed a weird delta between per-route invoice previews and the model-usage heatmap. route A shows 0.0 tokens but model alias 'gpt-lite-v2' shows ~12k tokens for the same tenant window
alex: can you paste the query ranges? could be a time-join issue between the route_resolver and the billing joins
maya: 2026-03-22T02:00-03:00 UTC. heatmap (model_id) is populated; console route card (route_alias -> aggregated tokens) shows zero. looks like attribution is being lost when alias swap happened at 02:15
sam: timeline: tenant updated route to use alias 'gpt-lite' -> we rolled alias to 'gpt-lite-v2' at 02:13. edge emitted events with model_alias field empty for a short window during the rollout. ingest then fell back to route_id only. aggregator groups by route_alias first, then route_id, so empty alias ends up in orphan bin
kevin: aggregator behavior: group_by alias if present else fallback to route_id, then emit per-route token cards. sounds like orphan bin not surfaced to console so preview looks zero
maya: right. affected tenant invoices show tokens in raw ledger but console preview grouped under "unattributed" which our preview query filters out intentionally to avoid noise
ops-bot: creating ticket MET-1210: "billing: missing route_alias attribution during alias rollout causes invoice-preview mismatch"
ops-bot: MET-1210 created by maya. severity P2. owner: TBD
alex: quick mitigation: change aggregator to emit both alias_group and fallback_route_group, and tag events where alias is null with route_resolution_id so console can join. we should also add a temporary console card that surfaces "unattributed tokens" by route_resolution_id for debugging
kevin: patch idea: aggregator emits an extra dimension 'route_resolution_id' (stable UUID assigned by route-resolver) on metering events. console preview will prefer route_alias but can fallback to route_resolution_id for attribution. Backwards compatible because it's additive
sam: caveat: route_resolution_id currently ephemeral in route-resolver cache (TTL 30s). need to persist route_resolution_id in the sideband datastore with TTL >= invoice join window (1h) so joins later in pipeline can resolve it
rina: can we instead emit both 'route_alias' and 'route_id' from the edge? that avoids extra lookup at aggregator but requires proxy change and rollout. might be simpler long-term but slower to deploy
alm: (typo)
kevin: prefer minimal edge changes for fast mitigation. plan: 1) aggregator emits route_resolution_id dimension from resolver (no edge change) 2) console adds fallback join on route_resolution_id 3) plan edge data model change in next sprint to always include alias+route_id in events
sam: agree. we'll need a small mapping table persisted for 2h. ops-bot: MET-1210 updated: owner sam, task: persist route_resolution_id mapping in redis with 2h TTL
maya: console UX: show a small "attribution confidence" pill (high/medium/low). If route_alias missing but route_resolution_id used, mark medium and show tooltip "alias missing during rollout"
alex: tests: simulate alias swap with 5s of empty alias emissions, ensure console preview matches ledger after aggregator change. Also add a dashboard card: orphan_tokens_by_tenant, orphan_tokens_by_route_resolution_id
e.g. alex: suggested query for orphan tokens

SELECT tenant_id, route_resolution_id, sum(tokens) as orphan_tokens
FROM metering_raw
WHERE route_alias IS NULL AND timestamp >= now() - interval '3 hours'
GROUP BY tenant_id, route_resolution_id

kevin: preview implications: our sampling pipeline currently picks events before attribute enrichment. we'll need to shift sampling to after enrichment or apply a light-weight enrichment step (route_resolution_id join) in preview path. I'll own preview changes
sam: operational plan: canary aggregator change for 1h on staging, then 2h canary on prod for small tenant cohort. will monitor orphan_tokens / attribution_confidence metrics
maya: canary cohort: 20 tenants across different route types. I'll own selection. alert if orphan_tokens > 0.5% of total tokens for cohort in 30m window
ops-bot: scheduled MET-1210 canary: 03:30 UTC tomorrow. owners: sam (aggregator), kevin (preview), maya (cohort), alex (console UX).
alex: follow-ups: add backfill job to scan last 6h for events missing alias and re-run enrichment using route_resolution_id mapping if available. also add note in runbook: if alias rollout in last 12h, check orphan_tokens and run backfill job
rina: long-term: standardize edge to always emit route_alias + route_id + route_resolution_id. will propose in infra-apis RFC next sprint
maya: thanks. this should clear up confused customers and reduce support noise
ops-bot: reminder: MET-1210 canary kickoff 03:30 UTC tomorrow
